title: AMP body: key.revocation
description: body.type = 'key.revocation' — Broadcast that an agent key is revoked.

agent_id.description: agent:// URI of the agent whose key is revoked
agent_id.title: Agent Id

revoked_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (with UTC offset) from which the key is revoked. key_rotation: the key may not sign anything at or after this instant. key_compromise / agent_decommissioned: every signature by the key is invalid regardless of this value.
revoked_at.title: Revoked At

replacement_key_id.description: Replacement key ID, if key was rotated
replacement_key_id.title: Replacement Key Id

compromised_at.description: key_compromise only: informational RFC 3339 estimate of when the key was compromised, for audit. Verifiers MUST NOT use it to keep any signature valid. Omitted from the signed canonical form when absent.
compromised_at.title: Compromised At

signature.description: Ed25519 signature proving authenticity of this revocation
signature.title: Signature

x-amp-constraints: signature MUST verify over the canonical form (tests/vectors/key_revocation.json)
revoked_at and compromised_at MUST be valid calendar instants
compromised_at is only allowed with reason key_compromise and MUST NOT be after revoked_at

key_compromise / agent_decommissioned invalidate every signature by the key regardless of its timestamp; key_rotation invalidates only signatures made at or after revoked_at (WIRE-BINDING section 12.12.1)
